description: FICTIONAL patients only. Each case is a short manual transcript, the doctor-reviewed facts (used as the clinician summary so that the evaluation isolates the assistant), the doctor-entered patient context and questions with the behaviour the safeguards should produce. Used by data/evaluation/evaluate_assistant.py. Expected behaviours describe system safeguards, not clinical correctness.
